g.text: Recipe editing: selected classes and relationships
Only feature-relevant members are shown; constructors and most recipe getters are omitted.
RecipeChanges and Recipe hold immutable values and copied, read-only ingredient lists.
RecipeChanges: a null scalar or empty ingredient list means keep the original field.
Recipe: nutrition is nonnegative and ingredients contain at least one positive-quantity item.
Solid arrows show stored references; dashed arrows show dependencies or interface realization.
RecipeBook is passed to execute, not retained by EditRecipeCommand.
The displayed index starts at 1; RecipeBook.replace uses a zero-based index.
